FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 153
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/04/2026
Senate Bill 153 as introduced would appropriate the sum of $36,635,222 from the Children
First Trust Fund (CFTF) for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027 as follows:
Agency FY 2027 Appropriation ($)
Alabama Department of Human Resources 8,853,073
Department of Youth Services 8,107,317
Department of Public Health 4,771,403
State Multiple Needs Children's Fund 4,358,550
Juvenile Probation Services Fund 3,972,864
Alabama Department of Mental Health 2,142,457
Children's Trust Fund 2,000,000
Alabama Medicaid Agency 1,390,782
Department of Forensic Sciences 418,413
Alcoholic Beverage Control Board 414,077
Department of Rehabilitation Services 206,286
Total Appropriation 36,635,222
This bill would also provide that these funds be conditioned upon receipt of tobacco revenues,
and any remaining sums at the end of the fiscal year would remain in the CFTF and not revert to
the State General Fund (SGF) or to any other fund. This bill would also transfer approximately
$9,630,000 in CFTF monies allocated to the State Board of Education to the SGF for FY 2027.
In addition to the above appropriation, this bill would also appropriate $43,789,530 from
additional tobacco settlement funds for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027 to the
following entities:
Agency FY 2027 Appropriation ($)
Alabama Medicaid Agency 24,836,383
21st Century Debt Service 16,000,000
Department of Senior Services - Medicaid Waiver 1,682,759
Senior Services Trust Fund 1,141,922
Page 1

Senior Services Trust Fund 1,141,922
FN-11IJ77ZL-1
Department of Early Childhood Education 128,466
Total Appropriation 43,789,530
This bill would also require that: (1) any additional tobacco revenues available for FY 2027 be
conditionally appropriated, conditioned upon the recommendation of the Finance Director, the
Chairs of the House Ways and Means General Fund and Senate Finance and Taxation General
Fund Committees and the approval of the Governor; and (2) notification be provided to
legislators representing an area where a grant from the CFTF is to be awarded ten days before
the funds reach the recipient agency.
